name: Motto! DEBUTOPIA
source:
Young boy Yorimasa has a thing for curvy girls, and meets three sisters.

Three deliciously corpulent, squeezable, loveable chubby girls... and all in the same family! All in the same household! His new life under this overfull house of plenty is a paradise.

Yorimasa's longtime wishes converge on a hot christmas morning. Which sister will he celebrate with? Can he somehow get all three at once!?
He's wrapped in a world of womanly softness! Give him a goal! Or will he be smothered!? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105372.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
年轻的寄正对丰满的女孩情有独钟，并遇见了三姐妹。

三个美味、丰满、柔软又惹人怜爱的胖女孩，而且还来自同一个家庭！生活在这座幸福过剩的房子里，对寄正来说简直就是天堂。

寄正长久以来的愿望，在一个炎热的圣诞早晨汇聚到了一起。他会和哪位姐姐共度节日？还是能把三个人一起收入怀中！？

他被女性柔软的世界包围。给他设定一个目标吧！否则，他会被彻底包裹其中！？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE105372.html]DLsite English[/url]]
